plan.r: preview <- tt_plan("Is this a complaint?", c("one", "two")); cat(preview$records, preview$requests, "\n")

decide.r: cat(tt_decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today")$results[[1]]$value, "\n")

choose.r: cat(tt_choose(list(choose = "Which team owns this?", options = c("the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else")), "please route this ticket")$results[[1]]$value, "\n")

tag.r: cat(unlist(tt_tag(list(tag = "Which words appear?", labels = c("refund", "shipping")), "the refund and the shipping")$results[[1]]$value), "\n")

score.r: cat(tt_score(list(score = "How urgent is this?", levels = c("Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate.")), "maybe later")$results[[1]]$value, "\n")

filter.r: out <- tt_filter("Is this a complaint?", c("good morning", "I demand a refund today"))$results; cat(vapply(out, `[[`, "", "input"), "\n")
filter.expected: good morning I demand a refund today

rank.r: out <- tt_rank("Is this a complaint?", c("good morning", "I demand a refund today"))$results; cat(vapply(out, `[[`, "", "input"), "\n")
rank.expected: good morning I demand a refund today

find.r: cat(tt_find("Which line asks for money back?", c("good morning", "I want a refund"))$results[[1]]$value, "\n")

files.form.json: {"version":1,"questions":{"refund":{"decide":"Does the customer ask for a refund?"},"complaint":{"decide":"Is this a complaint?","threshold":0.5}}}

annotate.r: out <- tt_annotate(tt_question(file = "form.json"), data.frame(body = "I demand a refund today"), options = list(field = list("/body")))$results[[1]]$value; cat(out$refund, out$complaint, "\n")

recognize.r: question <- list(version = 1, recognize = list(kinds = list(person = NULL, organization = NULL, place = NULL))); found <- tt_recognize(question, "Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.")$results[[1]]$value$entities; cat(vapply(found, function(row) paste(row$text, row$kind, row$start, row$end, sep = "|"), ""), "\n")

relate.r: alerts <- data.frame(name = c("Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "The payments database ran out of disk space."), kind = "alert"); question <- list(version = 1, relate = list(relations = list(list(name = "caused_by", source = "alert", target = "alert")))); edges <- tt_relate(question, alerts)$results[[1]]$value; cat(vapply(edges, `[[`, "", "relation"), vapply(edges, `[[`, 0, "probability"), "\n")
